title: Tuesday Quick Tip
subtitle: Let them name it
hook: What would your players call your favorite drill?
intro: You call it the passing triangle.
The kids call it the pizza drill.
statement: A name kids choose is a drill kids remember.
q1: Do you let players name the drills —
q2: or keep simple names that explain the skill?
q3: Which drill names do kids ask for by name?
t1: Every team is different. But kids buy in
t2: when part of practice feels like theirs.
ctaLines: Kids vote. Silly names. Plain names only.
ctaPrompt: Share your best drill name below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
What would your players call your favorite drill?
You call it the passing triangle. The kids call it the pizza drill.
A name kids choose is a drill kids remember.
Kid names or plain names. There is no single right way.
Who names your drills? Share your habit in the comments.
